title: How Planes Actually Stay In The Sky
hook: A 400-ton metal tube shouldn't float in the air — but it does.

scenes.voiceover: Flight depends on four invisible forces battling each other constantly.
Engines create thrust, pushing the aircraft forward through the air.
As wings slice forward, air splits above and below them.
The curved top forces air to move faster, lowering its pressure.
Higher pressure underneath then pushes the wing upward, creating lift.
Lift overcomes gravity, and thrust overcomes drag from the air.
Pilots adjust flaps and angle to control all four forces.
That balance is the only thing keeping you in the sky.

cta: Follow for more things you never questioned.
description: Ever wondered how a massive metal aircraft defies gravity? Here's the simple physics behind flight explained in under a minute. #aviation #physics #howitworks #planes #avgeek #shorts
